family: Historical industry / sector classification and membership
meaning: An official date-addressable historical source path for Taiwan listed-electronics membership and electronics subindustry classification has been runtime-verified. The historical panel itself is not yet built, coverage-cleared, frozen, or outcome-authorized.

official_endpoint.existing_hengce_usage: The HENGCE daily-command-center legacy path already uses TWSE MI_INDEX type=13 for the electronics daily close. This audit extends the same official source family for historical classification recovery and does not authorize an alternate mother or fallback data tree.

runtime_verification.type_31_resolution: A prior multi-navigation browser run duplicated type=30 when attempting type=31. That result was rejected. TWSE official 2018 code documentation identifies 31 as 其他電子業, and an independent exact type=31 runtime call returned status OK with title 107年01月03日 每日收盤行情(其他電子業).

panel_build_rules.eligible_universe_anchor: Existing canonical HENGCE date-correct listed-electronics price universe; do not replace the canonical mother or create an alternate mother.

mandatory_pre_outcome_checks: For each valid trading date, compare union(types 24-31) with type=13; log every discrepancy rather than silently reconciling it.
Measure join coverage of same-date industry labels against the canonical date-correct eligible electronics universe.
Measure rolling coverage and missingness by date and ticker; coverage thresholds must be frozen before any forward outcome is opened.
Check duplicate (Date,Ticker) assignments and cross-subindustry collisions.
Spot-check known official classification-change effective dates against daily MI_INDEX classifications.
Do not infer labels for suspended/no-quotation observations; determine eligibility interaction from canonical same-date data and record unresolved cases explicitly.
Freeze the panel-builder code, source contract, coverage rule, and unknown policy before preregistering any selection challenger.
coverage_note: Existing broader HENGCE governance references high cross-sectional and rolling-validity standards, but this artifact deliberately does not silently transplant a numeric threshold into this family. The exact threshold must be declared before outcome inspection.
